subject: sci-dym
title: (R)SCI.DYM.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 172 (UPB(II)-34). SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From PROG-CONT: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: TRS (transition). From C-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: TR-INFO (trans-information). From TR-INFO: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics).
